messages:
maria: SLO alert just fired — hosted-infer-west-1 api.gateway 5xx rate jumped, SLO burn showing 15m at 6.3% (threshold 1%). Getting a couple of support escalations. Anyone oncall?
alex: I'm on it, pulling traces and probes now. Which endpoints? looks most traffic to /v1/generate-chat and /v1/embeddings
maria: customer tickets mention timeouts and 502/504s. support-bot shares: https://tickets.internal/RED-4721, RED-4722
support-bot: RED-4721: high-priority from AcmeCorp, reports 504s starting ~10:02 UTC. Attachments show curl -> hangs then 504.
jamal: can you paste the alert graph? also any deploys around 09:50-10:10?
alex: grafana: panel name "api.gateway.5xx_ratio" query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway"}[5m]))
alex: screenshot: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/5xx-spike?from=2173858800000&to=2173859600000
deploy-bot: canary rollout for model-server-v2 at 09:44 UTC -> finished 09:46 UTC, no rollback
nick: grabbing logs from edge-proxy -> seeing a lot of "upstream reset" and "timeout waiting for body". sample:
```
2026-03-15T09:58:03Z edge-proxy[req-id=abcd123] WARN "upstream reset by peer" target=model-pool-23
2026-03-15T09:58:05Z edge-proxy[req-id=abcd124] ERROR "timeout waiting for body" route=/v1/generate-chat status=504
```
ingrid: interestingly, auth failures spiked too for a subset: 401s from token-introspect service increased ~3x. Could be related if token service is slow and gateway marks as auth error -> but support tickets are 5xx not 401.
jamal: are traces missing for these 5xx requests? that's been a problem in past incidents (trace gap at edge)
alex: yes — sampling shows many 5xx requests have no traceparent header forwarded. Edge logs show no trace-id for ~40% of failed requests. trace-gap query:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",status=~"5..",trace_present="false"}[5m]))
```
maria: that explains lack of distributed traces. Could be the edge dropping headers when upstream times out.
nick: also seeing connection reset from model-server hosts: "connection reset by peer" and some OOM-kill events around 09:50 on model-server-45. syslog excerpt:
```
Mar 15 09:50:12 model-server-45 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4211 (python) total-vm:3450000kB...
```
jamal: OOM on model server + canary deploy earlier -> maybe new version has memory regression causing workers to hit OOM and reset connections.
ingrid: I pulled heap profiles for model-server-v2 and memory usage climbed after ~100 concurrent requests. Looks like KV-cache not releasing references.
alex: repro steps that reproduce 504 locally (non-prod):
```
for i in {1..200}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-infer.example/v1/generate-chat \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long prompt here"}],"max_tokens":2048}' &
done
```
Most requests start to see 502/504 after concurrency > ~120.
maria: immediate mitigation ideas?
jamal: fallback routing to stable model-server-v1 for heavy inference paths, or increase request-timeout at ingress to 45s temporarily so edge doesn't return 504 while downstream restarts. Also scale model-server pool up by +3 replicas.
nick: scaling helps but OOM indicates a memory leak we need to fix in model-server. short term: reduce concurrency per worker (env var MAX_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=8) and spin up more pods.
ingrid: I can push a config patch to reduce concurrency and increase replica count in the autoscaler. Will run as a controlled rollup.
alex: I'll add a temporary routing policy: weight 80% -> model-server-v1, 20% -> v2 for canary.
maria: support, can you notify impacted customers with a short blurb and ETA? support-bot: posting to customers affected: AcmeCorp, BetaApp.
support-bot: message posted to AcmeCorp contact and created follow-up RED-4723 for updates
jamal: long-term action: revert model-server-v2 until memory leak root cause is fixed and add test harness that runs heavy concurrency memory profile during canary.
alex: note: we also saw trace propagation dropped — add a middleware check to preserve traceparent header even on early error paths.
maria: final action list:
- jamal -> open postmortem ticket and track rollback + root cause (owner: jamal)
- ingrid -> push concurrency/replica patch (temp) and monitor (owner: ingrid)
- alex -> weighted routing change and trace header middleware PR (owner: alex)
- nick -> collect full OOM logs and core dumps (owner: nick)
- support-bot -> customer comms and ticket updates (owner: support)
maria: I'll keep this thread updated. if anyone sees new clusters of 5xx in other regions ping immediately. :warning:
deploy-bot: rollback recommendation: rollback canary model-server-v2 -> approved by oncall
jamal: thanks everyone, creating RED-POSTMORTEM-2173859000 and linking this thread.
